import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int Mod;
    static int n, k;
    static long[] fac;
    static long[] dfac;
    static long[] inv;
    static long[][] f;
    
    static long ksm(int a, int x) {
        long ans = 1;
        long w = a;
        while (x > 0) {
            if ((x & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * w) % Mod;
            }
            w = (w * w) % Mod;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static long solve(int use, int S) {
        if (f[use][S] != -1) return f[use][S];
        long ret = 0;
        if (S == 0) {
            ret = fac[n];
            for (int i = 1; i <= use; ++i) {
                ret = (ret * (k - i + 1)) % Mod;
            }
            f[use][S] = ret;
            return ret;
        }
        if (use > k) return 0;
        int lbit = S & (-S);
        int U = S - lbit;
        for (int T = U; ; T = (T - 1) & U) {
            ret = (ret + dfac[S - T] * solve(use + 1, T)) % Mod;
            if (T == 0) break;
        }
        f[use][S] = ret;
        return ret;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        Mod = sc.nextInt();
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(ksm(k, n));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        fac = new long[n + 1];
        dfac = new long[n + 1];
        inv = new long[n + 1];
        f = new long[19][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 18; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j)
                f[i][j] = -1;
        fac[0] = dfac[0] = fac[1] = dfac[1] = inv[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % Mod;
            inv[i] = (long)(Mod - (Mod / i) * inv[Mod % i] % Mod) % Mod;
            dfac[i] = (dfac[i - 1] * inv[i]) % Mod;
        }
        System.out.println((ksm(k, n) - solve(0, n) + Mod) % Mod);
        sc.close();
    }
}
